mapper.select: SELECT no,title,star,student_count,pay_price,regular_price,content,images,thumbnail,name,email,TO_CHAR(profile_desc) FROM course c JOIN member m ON member_id=instructor_no WHERE member_id=#{member_id} ORDER BY title ASC

SELECT c.member_id,c.course_no,c.is_completed,c.progress,TO_CHAR(c.regdate,'yyyy.mm.dd') as regdate,TO_CHAR(c.last_accessed,'yyyy.mm.dd') as lastaccessed,m.name FROM course_enrollment c JOIN member m ON c.member_id=m.member_id WHERE c.course_no=#{course_no}
